meaning: Frozen auxiliary equilibrium increments are compared at an oracle actual initial configuration, to distinguish action sensitivity/dynamic mismatch from an erroneous absolute body anchor. This is not a claim that the controller used physical truth.

posthoc_lag_scan.interpretation: Only a diagnostic correlation of recorded quasistatic increments and actual dynamic response; irregular samples are linearly interpolated, no plant parameter/control gain is fitted or changed.

windows.one_interval_limit: quasistatic prediction vs dynamic physical response; sign mismatch alone cannot be attributed solely to wrong K
